name: Slotted Bag
description: Fixed-slot inventory with stacking and rarity metadata, built on the Core Inventory primitive. A run that crosses between regions tears the whole build down and rebuilds it, so anything a player earned has to be handed to the next build through a DECLARED input or it is silently lost — which is how an RPG hands back a fresh character every time you walk off the edge of the map. That is what the initial-state input below is for: it is the same rule economy.currency's startingBalance follows, and it is a request's business to supply, never this component's to remember.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: initialItems
inputs.description: What the bag already holds when the build starts. Stacking and the slot limit apply to it exactly as they do to anything picked up afterwards, so a carried bag that no longer fits is refused at the boundary rather than quietly overflowing.
